prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: one deliberately unfinished design-comparison raster sketch of a Blood Bowl Sevens league website, landscape 1440x1000.
Primary request: Industrial streetwear graphical grammar adapted to a functional tabletop tournament website for existing players in Gata league, Yerevan. First desktop viewport, compact horizontal navigation, season and match tasks visually dominant, compact team panel and rules index secondary.
Composition: edge-to-edge flat WEBSITE viewport. Slim top navigation with small plain Gata League wordmark at left, greeked navigation strokes and small controls at right. Generous but purposeful content margins. Large quoted heading “Season”, strong squared section geometry. Main broad season/matches work area with compact rows and prominent orange action tags. Secondary narrower right column with compact team panel above rules index. Small lower table area just entering viewport. Clear scan hierarchy, useful density, hard edges, restrained diagonal separators, industrial bold typography for the two allowed headings. No huge promotional hero.
Color palette: #17191C charcoal black, #F7F7F4 off-white, #DE642E orange for action tags. Flat matte solid fills, simple thin rules.
Style/medium: low to medium fidelity deliberately unfinished interface sketch, rough short greeked strokes replacing copy, square labelled areas, industrial graphic layout, no hand-drawn physical object. Reference the graphical grammar of industrial streetwear editorial labels without recreating any outside brand.
Text constraint CRITICAL: The ONLY legible text anywhere in the image is “Gata League” and “Season”. All other headings, navigation, buttons, rows, teams, fixtures, scores, tabs and metadata must be indistinct nonalphabetic greeked strokes. NO invented names, numbers, dates, scores, slogans, words, initials, logos or status. Do not render any letters beyond the two approved phrases.
Avoid: poster, machinery illustration, giant typography dominating useful interface, device frame, browser chrome, photography, texture, gloss, gradients, 3D, shadows, rounded SaaS cards, invented emblem, fabricated league data. Show an actual functional tournament interface layout, not a brand moodboard.
refinement: Edit this website sketch to remove all fabricated data and imagery while keeping its layout, colors, navigation, orange tags, and Season heading. Replace EVERY team emblem, skull, symbol, pictogram and number with a plain small square or horizontal grey placeholder stroke. Especially remove all numbers in the lower table left column. Remove the ornamental texture/stripe graphic in the bottom right and make it an empty solid charcoal outlined panel. Flatten any texture to clean matte solid colors. The ONLY legible text must remain 'Gata League' and 'Season'; everything else must be nonalphabetic greeked strokes. Keep the functional season/matches left area and two compact right side panels. Deliberately unfinished UI sketch, no decoration. Render landscape 1440x1000.
